description: When a digital ATIS broadcast heard at a time stops being the airport's: two hours after it was heard, two of the updates AIM 4-1-13 asks ('ATIS broadcast must be updated upon the receipt of any official hourly and special weather'); a new letter writes over it before then.

heard.description: When it was heard, Unix seconds.

ends.description: When it is no longer the airport's, Unix seconds.
